title: AutoReplant Plus
description: Fast farming QoL: auto replant, optional seed cost, hoe-only mode.
body:
# AutoReplant Plus

Overview
AutoReplant Plus keeps farms flowing by replanting mature crops after harvest with optional seed cost.

Highlights
- Auto replant for mature crops with configurable delay.
- Optional seed consumption or free replant mode.
- Hoe requirement toggle for balance.
- Supports wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart, cocoa, berries.

Commands
- /autoreplant [status|on|off|reload]

Permissions
- autoreplantplus.use

Config
- require-hoe, free-replant, replant-delay-ticks

Tags
farming, crops, autoreplant, seeds, hoe, survival, qol

Compatibility
Loaders: spigot, paper, purpur
Game versions: 1.16.5 - 1.21.1
